mapper.sql: FROM social_match sm JOIN facility f ON f.facility_id = sm.facility_id AND f.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN sport s ON s.sport_id = sm.sport_id JOIN region r ON r.region_id = f.region_id
mapper.select:
SELECT sm.photo_url
AND sm.photo_url IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm.photo_url) <> '' ORDER BY sm.start_at, sm.match_id LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS room_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sm.status = #{recruitingStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS recruiting_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN sm.status = #{matchedStatus} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS matched_count

SELECT sm.sport_id, COUNT(*) AS room_count
GROUP BY sm.sport_id

SELECT sm.match_id, sm.title, sm.created_by, sm.sport_id, s.name AS sport_name, f.facility_id, f.name AS facility_name, f.address, r.name AS region_name, sm.start_at, sm.end_at, sm.min_participants, sm.max_participants, sm.team_a_capacity, sm.team_b_capacity, sm.fee_per_person, sm.required_skill, sm.status, sm.captain_a_participant_id, sm.captain_b_participant_id, sm.photo_url
WHERE sm.match_id = #{matchId}
SELECT sport_id, name FROM sport ORDER BY sport_id
SELECT region_id, name FROM region WHERE parent_region_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name
